interstages.label: 3.7 m skinned interstage
interstages.note: Length is 0.6 × diameter. Mass is π D L × 20 kg/m². A straight skin adds no Cd.

interstages.label: 3.7 m open truss
interstages.note: About 45% of a skinned shell of this size. The open bay adds drag.

interstages.label: 9 m vented hot-staging ring
interstages.note: Perforated band, 85% of a solid skin. Length is 0.6 × diameter.

interstages.label: Flare 3.7 m to 2.4 m
interstages.note: Base is wider, so the flare is stabilizing. Mass is the composite frustum.

interstages.label: Shoulder 5 m to 3.7 m
interstages.note: Upper end is wider. That moves the center of pressure forward.
